excerpt.zh: 一层厚厚的玻璃和金属覆盖在这颗原本贫瘠的行星上，或许暗示着它过去发生了某种灾难性事件。
excerpt.en: A thick layer of glass and metal covers this otherwise barren planet, perhaps hinting at some sort of cataclysmic event in its past.

texts.zh:
我们发现了明显的迹象，迹象表明[From.Planet.GetName]曾经人口稠密。然而，尽管不知道是什么摧毁了他们文明，摧毁都做得非常彻底：几乎没有发现有用的遗骸。

我们的扫描仪在地表深处探测到几个可能曾经支持生命的大洞。也许我们会在那里有更多的运气。
texts.en:
We have discovered clear signs that [From.Planet.GetName] was once densely populated. However, whatever destroyed their civilization did a very thorough job of it: very few useful remains have been found.

Our scanners have detected several large cavities deep below the surface that may once have supported life. Perhaps we will have more luck there.

texts.zh: 我们对[From.Planet.GetName]上的洞穴系统的挖掘发现了保存完好、规模宏大的地下高科技社会遗迹。许多废墟的状况出奇的好，我们设法找到了[Owner.GetResearchers]所描述的加密数据水晶“图书馆”。希望这些可以对这里发生的事情有所了解。
texts.en: Our excavation of the cave systems on [From.Planet.GetName] has found well-preserved remnants of an underground, high technology society built on a vast scale. Many of the ruins are in surprisingly good condition, and we have managed to find what our [Owner.GetResearchers] are describing as a "library" of encrypted data crystals. Hopefully, these can shed some light on what happened here.

texts.zh: 一个在[FromFrom.Planet.GetName]上探索废墟的[Owner.GetTeamMember]最近失踪了。经过短暂的搜索，我们找到了一具可能属于[Root.Owner.Species.GetName]的[Owner.GetSpeciesRemnantName]。我们的[Owner.GetResearchers]毫不怀疑这些遗骸是我们失踪的[Owner.GetTeamMember]的遗骸，但他们对尸体如何如此迅速地分解感到困惑。他们敦促我们在接下来的调查中保持谨慎。
texts.en: A [Owner.GetTeamMember] exploring the ruins on [FromFrom.Planet.GetName] recently disappeared. After a short search, we found a [Owner.GetSpeciesRemnantName] that seems to have belonged to a [Root.Owner.Species.GetName]. Our [Owner.GetResearchers] are in no doubt that these remains are what's left of our missing [Owner.GetTeamMember], but they are baffled about how the body decayed quite this quickly. They urge caution as we continue our investigations.

After a short search, we found a [Owner.GetSpeciesRemnantName] that seems to have belonged to a [Root.Owner.Species.GetName]. Our [Owner.GetResearchers] are in no doubt that these remains are what's left of our missing [Owner.GetTeamMember], but they are baffled as to what exactly killed them - the process seems to have been fairly instantaneous. They urge caution as we continue our investigations.

texts.zh:
我们解析来自[From.Planet.GetName]洞穴中的数据水晶时，拼凑出了一个陷入困境的星球的景象。

这个星球曾经是一个繁荣的文明的中心，被称为伊兰尼基金会。在那个文明的后期，伊兰尼人越来越倾向于囤积知识，而不关心物质问题，比如生育。结果，他们的人口迅速减少。他们的领袖对他们不断减少的人数感到震惊，他们试图找到永生的技术解决方案。在这一点上，记录变得越来越稀少——尽管它似乎早于迫使他们进入地下的某种灾难——目前尚不清楚他们的努力有什么结果。
texts.en:
As we interpret the data crystals from the caves on [From.Planet.GetName], we begin piecing together a picture of a troubled planet.

The planet was once the center of a prosperous civilization known as the Ilanii Foundation. During that civilization's latter years, the Ilanii turned more and more to the hoarding of knowledge instead of more material matters such as procreation. As a result, their population fell rapidly. Alarmed by their dwindling numbers, their leaders attempted to find a technological solution for immortality. Records become scarcer around this point - though it appears to predate whatever cataclysm forced them underground - and it is not clear yet what results their efforts yielded.

texts.zh:
我们现在可以拼凑出伊兰尼尝试永生的结果了。看来，他们远没有永生，而是制造了一种可怕的威胁——一群能够快速繁殖并且几乎立即吞噬任何有机物的微生物……就像我们团队失踪成员身上发生过的事情那样。

由此产生的大灾难消灭了大部分人口。幸存者分裂成两组：其中一组，不愿放弃[From.Planet.GetName]，遁入深处，在我们发现的那个密不透风的洞穴中重建他们的文明。然而，从长远来看，这种解决方案被证明是不可持续的，最终微生物找到了进入它们的栖息地的方法。洞穴成了他们的坟墓。

另一组流亡星海，通过彻底摧毁地表使其无法居住的方法来强制执行行星隔离。 从此以后，他们将生活在小飞地中，并致力于保存他们文明中失落的知识，最终演变成现代[curator_enclave_country.GetName] 的祖先之一。
texts.en:
We can now piece together what became of the Ilanii's attempt at immortality. It appears that, far from bringing them everlasting life, they created a terrible menace - a swarm of microorganisms capable of multiplying rapidly and almost instantly devouring any organic matter... as must have happened to our team's lost member.

The resulting cataclysm wiped out much of the population. The survivors splintered into two groups: one, unwilling to give up [From.Planet.GetName], took to the depths, recreating their civilization in air-tight pockets such as the one we found. However, this solution proved unsustainable in the long run, and eventually the microorganism found its way into their habitats; the caves became their tombs.

The other group instead went into exile, enforcing a planetary quarantine by utterly obliterating the surface, rendering it uninhabitable. They would henceforth live in small enclaves and dedicate themselves to preserving the lost knowledge of their civilization, eventually morphing into one of the ancestors of the modern [curator_enclave_country.GetName].

label.zh: 这种有机微生物将成为一种很好的武器。
label.en: This microorganism will make a fine weapon.

label.zh: 什么都吃的微生物？你们的远房亲戚来咯。
label.en: All-Devouring Microorganism? Meet a your macro match.

label.zh: 隔离这个星球，只允许谨慎的研究。
label.en: Quarantine the planet, allowing only careful study.

texts.zh: 我们的调查表明，一个致力于知识积累的文明残余在[curator_poi.GetName] 恒星系寻求庇护。
texts.en: Our investigations suggest that the remnants of a civilization dedicated to the accumulation of knowledge sought their refuge in the [curator_poi.GetName] system.
